subject.title: bug: withAllowedHostname only updates allowedHostnames, not hostnameAllowlist — breaks navigate with non-empty hostnameAllowlist

question: Should OpenClaw fix this by granting the selected CDP host across both hostname fields, or by passing a separate CDP-control policy into Playwright connection and target lookup while leaving page-navigation policy unchanged?
rationale: The report is a real source-level mismatch, but the fix changes a browser SSRF control boundary and current tests encode part of the stricter behavior, so maintainer intent is needed before relaxing it.

options.title: Fix control-plane policy only
options.body: Keep page navigation checks strict, but ensure Playwright/CDP connection and target lookup use the scoped CDP control policy so loopback control traffic cannot self-block.

options.title: Keep strict hostnameAllowlist behavior
options.body: Require users with `hostnameAllowlist` to explicitly include the CDP host and update docs/tests to make that operator burden intentional.

options.title: Defer to broader SSRF design
options.body: Leave this issue open behind the broader private-network confirmation and allow/block policy design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/38931.

recommendation.title: Fix control-plane policy only
recommendation.body: Keep page navigation checks strict, but ensure Playwright/CDP connection and target lookup use the scoped CDP control policy so loopback control traffic cannot self-block.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared helper implicated by the report and have the clearest recent history on the exact policy helper surface.
